description: This file defines the EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair class, which encapsulates a collection and a lookup setting related to LDAP user lookup. It provides getter methods to access these properties.

classes.name: EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair
classes.description: A class that pairs a collection of LDAP entries with a specific lookup setting, facilitating LDAP operations related to user information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection and lookup setting properties.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Getter that returns the LDAP collection.

methods.name: getLookupSetting
methods.description: Getter that returns the LDAP user lookup setting.
